meta.name: alterlab-primekg
meta.description: Queries the Precision Medicine Knowledge Graph (PrimeKG) for multiscale biomedical relationships across genes, drugs, diseases, phenotypes, pathways, and biological processes. Use when exploring drug-disease or gene-disease links, building disease-centric knowledge subgraphs, or sourcing relations for drug repurposing and precision-medicine analyses. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 查询精准医学知识图谱中的生物医学关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在研究药物-疾病或基因-疾病关系，需要结构化生物医学数据。
copy.tagline_en: Query biomedical relationships from the Precision Medicine Knowledge Graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are researching drug-disease or gene-disease relationships and need structured biomedical data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询精准医学知识图谱 PrimeKG，搜索基因、药物、疾病等实体，获取它们之间的关联关系，并分析疾病相关的基因、药物和表型。
howto.when: 当用户询问药物与疾病的关联、基因与疾病的关系，或要求分析疾病背景、寻找药物重定位机会时触发。

say.text: 搜索与阿尔茨海默病相关的基因。
say.note: 返回疾病关联的基因列表。

say.text: 查找阿司匹林与心脏病之间的路径。
say.note: 返回药物到疾病的可能通路。

say.text: 分析糖尿病的疾病背景。
say.note: 返回相关基因、药物、表型等摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the Precision Medicine Knowledge Graph (PrimeKG) to search for entities like genes, drugs, and diseases, retrieve their relationships, and analyze disease context including associated genes, drugs, and phenotypes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about drug-disease or gene-disease links, requests disease context analysis, or explores drug repurposing opportunities.

say_en.text: Search for genes associated with Alzheimer's disease.
say_en.note: Returns a list of disease-associated genes.

say_en.text: Find paths between aspirin and heart disease.
Analyze the disease context of diabetes.
say_en.note: Returns a summary of related genes, drugs, phenotypes, etc.
